mechanism: Erythromycin inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing tramadol metabolism and increasing tramadol and its active metabolite (O-desmethyltramadol) concentrations, elevating risk of toxicity and seizures.
action: Monitor closely for signs of tramadol toxicity (dizziness, confusion, seizures, serotonin syndrome); consider alternative antibiotic or reduce tramadol dose; avoid if possible.
